author: Riya Sharma
text: We evaluated both SQLite with WAL mode and PostgreSQL for our local checkout service. We decided on SQLite with WAL mode because WAL mode handles our 200 concurrent checkout queries with zero lock contention and avoids deploying a heavyweight RDS cluster during early pilot phases.
